During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] deployed a '''mining complex''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alabash]]. Staffed entirely by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and controlled by a [[Terreene Brainiac]] class of [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] named [[Control (droid)|Control]], it was capable of extracting and processing six hundred [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of [[alantium]] per [[Standard month/Legends|month]]. The complex was a five hundred [[Meter/Legends|meter]] by five hundred meter platform that hovered above the surface of the planet at a height of twenty meters. The complex sucked up a one hundred-meter-wide section of the surface, extracted the valuable ore, and extruded the remains behind the facility. [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] [[Green squad]] was tasked with infiltrating and destroying the facility.<ref name="Freedom" />
